checks.name: Discovery feed and personalized ranking for User A vs User B
Query filtering: platform, location, jobType, skills
Job Details endpoint with provenance and metadata
Job actions: Save, Mark Applied, Hide and Unhide
Two-Account Isolation: User B unaffected by User A actions
Query parameter pollution and invalid ID rejection
Strict action rate-limiting and safe fallback
Playwright browser UI integration with live MongoDB backend

limitations: External provider HTTP ingestion is mocked at the transport boundary to ensure zero paid API calls and no external network dependency.
Test database is completely isolated from production and automatically dropped upon completion.
